bank_rules.balance_sheet: R+L=D+E at every event; unpaid simple interest is a separate cash-basis contractual memo
bank_rules.default: At bullet maturity, service-budget shortfall causes negotiated zero-recovery legal forgiveness; principal asset and debtor liability disappear, deposits do not.
bank_rules.lending: Explicit temporary-income-return forecast, borrower principal cap and bank equity/outstanding-principal minimum10%; no credible future income means refusal.
bank_rules.profit: Only paid interest retained above opening capital is distributed to ultimate firm owners. Principal is never profit or GDP.
bank_rules.service: Wages before service; firm service from positive operating surplus before dividends; worker service at20% current received wages/dividends. Opening vintages only; unspent same-round advances cannot service debt.
bank_rules.termination: Stop at first unpaid wage, bank capital depletion(E=0), or insolvency(E<0). Remaining loans/memos are retained; no subsequent recovery simulated.

opening_capitalization: Separate reset: owners withdraw20 from firms original100 buffers and invest20 in bank equity; workers60+owners40+firms80 deposits=180; R200=D180+E20.
units: invented currency; zero-indexed model rounds, rates per round, not calendar APR
